verdict.rationale: Extend documents that every processing endpoint (extract, classify, split, parse, edit) supports both synchronous and asynchronous modes. It also lists a 'Fast mode' and base-processor choices that trade accuracy against speed, so the core of a fast sync path for interactive use is present. However, no latency figures or per-mode response times appear anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: documented latency numbers per mode (e.g., seconds-level guarantees for sync/fast mode), explicit guidance on sync-mode limits for interactive apps, independent or hands-on confirmation of response speed.
